pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: We tested on the old AMD Ryzen 5 3500U and it was fine 😁👍
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: There are some effects we use, but an integrated card should work fine on lower settings.
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: Did not test with VR.
  • Additional Notes: It should work on HDDs too. Dev tools are enabled so if you know what you're doing you can easily mod the game, fix bugs you encounter, etc. Contact us, we want to see what you managed 😋💯
